rows.title: Do data centers make nearby neighborhoods hotter?

rows.title: Is Colorado’s median home price higher than the national average?
rows.standfirst: Yes. Colorado’s median single-family home price was $220,000 higher than the U.S. median price in 2024, the most recent data available shows.

rows.title: What’s Working: Colorado homeowners insurance is among the most expensive in the US

rows.title: Do half of US adults under 30 live with their parents?
rows.standfirst: Yes. The Federal Reserve annual household survey found 49% of adults under the age of 30 still live with their parents, up from 37% in 2019.

rows.title: Keeping coal plants open in Colorado could cost $87M, with consumers paying the tab

rows.title: Can landlords in Colorado wait up to 60 days to return security deposits?
rows.standfirst: Yes. Landlords in Colorado generally must return a security deposit within 30 days after a lease ends, but the deadline can be extended to 60 days.
